name: San Sebastián de los Ballesteros (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Sebastián de los Ballesteros (the monogram of Charles III on blue and an arrow on green).
history: The flag was approved and published at the same time as the arms and is described as a rectangular flag of 2:3, white, with the crowned municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: San Sebastián de los Ballesteros arms — monogram of Charles III and arrow
